peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.2% below its local comparables; 20 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (67.6): 5.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 34 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Initial resale-wave effect: 28 of the 63 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Dec 2024–Nov 2025), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2015.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $904,000 ($1,935 psf, 452–484 sq ft; 6 resales, Jun 2025–May 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,848 psf (range $1,790–2,149); 4.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $41,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,358,888 ($1,961 psf, 570–775 sq ft; 13 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,152 psf (range $1,920–2,232); 8.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $132,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,030,000 ($2,141 psf, 936–1,054 sq ft; 14 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,264 psf (range $1,822–2,437); 5.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $117,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Dec 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 10 earlier resales do not start the wave. 10 months available from Dec 2025; measurable with data to Nov 2026. Observed: 5.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Braddell MRT about 450 m, Toa Payoh MRT about 830 m; closer than 6 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest First Toa Payoh Primary School about 490 m; more than 48 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 370 m), more than 28 of 51 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Toa Payoh Lorong 4 Blk 93 about 210 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 950 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (The Orie, 25 new sales, about 140 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 144 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 25 new sales and 595 resales (620 purchases); new sales were 4% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 1,630 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,850 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 595 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 24 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 595 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 739 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.5%). Planning-area private resales −13.1%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
